subject: general
question: The award (decision) made by the Lok Adalats is deemed to be a decree of a civil court and is final and binding on all parties because:

options.text: An appeal can be filed in the Supreme Court
A review petition can be filed
An appeal can be filed in the High Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**No appeal is permissible**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The award or decision of a Lok Adalat is deemed as equivalent to a decree of a civil court under the provisions of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
 
• Once a settlement is reached in Lok Adalat, it is binding on all parties and no appeal is permissible to challenge the decision.
 
• Lok Adalat promotes voluntary conciliation and consensus-based dispute resolution, ensuring quicker and cost-effective justice.
 
• It is designed to avoid prolonged litigation by resolving disputes amicably without the need for a formal trial.
 
• The finality of the award is emphasized to maintain the efficiency and credibility of Lok Adalats as an alternative dispute resolution mechanism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Adalat:**

 
 
• Lok Adalat (People's Court) is a statutory body under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
 
• It is organized to provide free legal aid and resolve disputes through conciliation and compromise.
 
• Cases like civil disputes, matrimonial disputes, labor disputes, and compoundable criminal cases are usually resolved by Lok Adalats.
 
 
 
• **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987:**
 
 
• This Act provides the framework for organizing Lok Adalats and ensuring free legal aid to economically weaker sections.
 
• It establishes State and District Legal Services Authorities to oversee the implementation of legal aid and Lok Adalats.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Lok Adalat:**
 
 
• Eliminates the lengthy process of litigation and provides speedy justice.
 
• Reduces the burden on regular courts and saves resources.
 
• Fosters mutual understanding and peace among disputing parties.
 
 
 
• **Binding Nature of Awards:**
 
 
• The award is final and cannot be appealed, ensuring quick and decisive resolution of disputes.
 
• Parties must voluntarily agree to the settlement before the award is passed.
